description: New security.yml workflow with fail-closed medium-or-higher gates: gitleaks, CodeQL (python + javascript-typescript) with a stdlib SARIF severity gate, Semgrep, Bandit, zizmor, atheris fuzz harnesses for the WARC verifier, CDX search and MCP JSON-RPC dispatch, node --test property tests, ClusterFuzzLite PR fuzzing, and a stdlib local gate runner (scripts/gate.py) mirroring CI including the ci.yml leak gate. Includes the prerequisite MCP dispatch extraction and WARC verifier hardening. ci.yml is untouched.
